active.packageId: Audit workflow gap-closure and client accounting implementation
active.scope: Local audit workflow, client accounting, scoped client file-request threads/uploads/downloads, GL intake, completeness, package, Office/PDF export, restatement, consolidation, journal-lineage, close-check and package-review slices.
active.nextAction: Implement source-bound schedules and guarded production integration for the IFRS advanced-method scope in STE-METH-APP-001-addendum; keep profiles fail-closed until complete statement and comparative rollforward verification passes. localEvidence.details: Profiles, periods, books, COA mappings, versioned TB profiles, signed-net/debit-credit normalization and multi-entity batches.

Portfolio counters, client index, search, CSV export and candidate/package lists use the actor's active firm-wide, direct client or exact engagement RoleGrant scope; engagement-only grants cannot expand to sibling engagements. Actors without an explicit scope see no firm data and receive actionable guidance. The web Release build passes at 69dc6ec, the shared tooltip helper syntax-checks at 0bea412, and the 212-test PostgreSQL suite passes on the same code-only UI series at 60c7c68.

The shared Blazor layout exposes current-route accounting navigation for the implemented workspace, evidence, package-review, roll-forward, restatement, consolidation and journal surfaces. The accounting workspace also pins a selected visible period's firm, group, legal entity, engagement, period, book, currency and package version; the selection is draft-restored and never broadens authorization. Unsupported workbenches are not represented as fake links. Web Release build passes at 4010963.

Capability profiles accept only ENTITY_REPORTING and AUDIT_ONLY client scopes or GROUP_REPORTING group scopes; unknown service kinds and mismatched client/group scopes are rejected. PostgreSQL regression coverage passes.

localEvidence.item: Client GL dimensions and currency defaults
localEvidence.details: Client-scoped branch, cost-centre, department, project and intercompany-counterparty definitions reject undefined nonblank GL values, including streaming chunks. Blank accounting setup/reporting currency defaults to QAR; source/import and FX-policy currencies remain explicit. Migration 20260921052800_ClientAccountingDimensionDefinitions and PostgreSQL regression coverage pass.

Direct and streaming GL imports preserve optional service dates in PostgreSQL, canonical content digests, line projections and archive transaction exports. Migration 20260921064940_PreserveGeneralLedgerServiceDate, focused regression coverage, full suite, release build, EF drift check and loopback restore evidence pass.

Completeness bridges optionally bind an approved prior-period sealed TB for the same entity, book, basis and currency, persist per-account opening-plus-movement residuals and the opening digest, count malformed journal groups, and disclose missing opening data or incomplete batch counts. Focused opening-rollforward and source-only disclosure coverage, the 212-test suite, Release build, EF drift check and loopback restore evidence pass. Migration 20260921072319_ReconcileGeneralLedgerOpeningMovement.

Zero-journal plans preserve the accepted source; posted journals apply only for NOT_REFLECTED decisions, REFLECTED contributes zero, UNKNOWN/PARTIALLY_REFLECTED blocks finalization, replacement datasets create new plans, layer identity prevents duplicate purpose application, and changed reflection decisions stale the plan. PostgreSQL adjustment-bridge and financial-statement regressions pass.

Reconciliation approval re-reads the exact dataset or GL-batch digest and client input generation; a changed source marks the reconciliation STALE and blocks approval. PostgreSQL regression coverage passes.

GL-backed bank-ledger schedules require a sealed, firm/client/engagement/legal-entity-scoped GL import batch with a matching raw or normalized hash, complete source-line coverage for the selected account codes and matching currency. Account-code matching is case-insensitive at the command boundary. The persisted GL control total is derived from those source lines; caller-supplied mismatches fail closed. Migration 20260921212202_ResolveScheduleControlSource, focused fieldwork coverage and the 218-test suite pass.

Client chart parent lookups are restricted to the target chart version; cross-version parent references and posting-account parents are rejected, while same-chart non-posting parent insertion remains supported. PostgreSQL regression coverage passes.
Draft taxonomy nodes can be inserted incrementally with parents from the same taxonomy version; cross-version parents and cycles are rejected. PostgreSQL regression coverage passes.

CSV/XLSX imports require and persist the selected reporting period, optional book and normalized basis; period currency/basis/book scope is checked at import, and completeness/TB reconciliation rejects mismatched stored context. Migration 20260921042350_BindTrialBalanceToReportingContext, PostgreSQL regression coverage and loopback restore evidence pass. Financial-package reporting-context binding is recorded separately below.

Typed GL imports, bounded resumable GL chunks with canonical digest/idempotent finalization, bounded paged reads, account-by-account completeness bridges, source-bound reconciliations that reject mismatched period/currency batches, and bounded specialist/analytical/journal-risk workflows.

GL completeness bridge calculation is enqueued through the existing local durable operation infrastructure, fenced to the sealed TB revision and exact scoped GL sources, published with operation/result lineage, and safely re-enqueued by the same idempotency key; PostgreSQL acceptance passes.

Reconciliation items must match the accepted/sealed source currency, cannot be future-dated beyond the reconciliation as-of date, require a disposition, normalize accepted currency codes and preserve explicit receivable/payable ageing basis, bucket rule/bucket, credit treatment and paired settlement date/reference; PostgreSQL regression coverage passes. Migration 20260921102055_AddReconciliationAgingEvidence.

A scoped fieldwork query returns gross absolute, signed/net, corrected and unadjusted difference totals by currency, so offsetting differences remain visible. Linked differences now persist a journal-impact.v2 payload from the exact journal revision and approved mapping lineage, including account/statement effects, profit/equity totals, disclosure buckets, explicit unmapped status and a payload hash. Difference records retain optional materiality and qualitative concerns, and reviewer-governed proposed/agreed/rejected/applied/reported states reject stale or unsupported impact evidence before verified-reflected status. PostgreSQL regression coverage, the 212-test suite, Release build, EF drift check and 75-migration restore drill pass; professional aggregate evaluation remains a separate control.

Bank reconciliations bind independently approved ledger and statement schedules, retain typed ledger/statement/timing/proposed-correction items with source and evidence references, calculate the unexplained residual without netting proposed corrections, require same-engagement draft-journal lineage for proposed items, and block approval and completion while unreconciled. PostgreSQL regression coverage, the 212-test suite, Release build, EF drift check and 75-migration loopback restore pass. Migration 20260921120505_AddAuditBankReconciliationWorkbench.

Authorized administrators can cancel only queued durable work without an active lease, with a bounded persisted disposition and append-only event. Cancelled operations are excluded from worker claims and cannot publish a partial local result; active or already-started work remains subject to lease expiry and reconciliation. PostgreSQL recovery coverage, the 212-test suite, Release build, EF drift check and 75-migration loopback restore pass. Migration 20260921123852_CancelDurableOperationDisposition.

Financial-package builds are enqueued through the existing local durable operation infrastructure, fenced to the approved mapping revision and finalized adjustment plan, published atomically with the operation result and safely re-enqueued by the same request identity; PostgreSQL acceptance passes.

Context-bound financial packages inherit the selected trial-balance period, optional book, normalized basis and currency, validate period dates and book scope, persist reporting-context foreign keys, and include the context in the deterministic package hash; PostgreSQL acceptance, migration drift and loopback restore pass.

Context-bound adjustment journals inherit and persist the validated dataset period, book, basis and currency, reject a book from another period, and retain that context through management decisions, posting, reversal and source-reflection lineage; PostgreSQL focused and full-suite coverage, migration drift and loopback restore pass.

Financial-package rendering is enqueued through the existing local durable operation infrastructure, fenced to the exact package revision, persists the exact framework/template-bound artifact bytes and SHA-256, and publishes that digest as operation result evidence; package-review decisions require the matching artifact; PostgreSQL acceptance passes.

Approved mapping destinations must match the taxonomy statement section. Financial-package validation persists separate statement cross-cast, accounting-equation, equity/profit, comparative-consistency and note-to-face outcomes, and deterministic artifacts render adjusted-snapshot, mapping-version and adjustment-plan lineage identifiers. Exact framework/template-bound artifact bytes and SHA-256 lineage are persisted, and package-review decisions reference the artifact. Financial-statement PostgreSQL regressions, the 210-test suite and Release build pass.

Analytical reviews default blank reporting currency to QAR within the selected client reporting period, validate period currency, persist deterministic input snapshots and replay hashes, disclose negative/seasonal movement flags, and require a persisted reviewer conclusion for approval. Secured aggregate summaries enforce client/engagement or explicit group scope, honor effective membership dates, and omit client/component identifiers. Journal-risk evidence preserves sample-selection, management-explanation and corroboration fields; bounded analysis returns criteria-versioned manual/year-end/high-value/reversal/missing-origin review indicators with source-origin and debit-amount evidence, without making automatic fraud findings. Focused aggregate and journal-risk coverage passes; the full 212-test suite, Release build, EF drift check and 75-migration loopback restore pass. Migration 20260921082006_AnalyticalReviewLineage remains the analytical-lineage migration; the current head also includes 20260921090305_PreserveAnalyticalReviewConclusion, 20260921092708_PersistFinancialPackageArtifacts, 20260921102055_AddReconciliationAgingEvidence, 20260921113403_AddAuditDifferenceEvaluationMetadata, 20260921120505_AddAuditBankReconciliationWorkbench, 20260921123852_CancelDurableOperationDisposition, 20260921134007_IntercompanyMatchReviewModes, 20260921134648_ReportingTaxonomyOverlays, 20260921144026_ExternalComponentPackWorkflow, 20260921144550_ExternalComponentPackCompatibilityBridge and 20260921150321_BindMappingsToClientCharts.

The PostgreSQL-backed AccountingBenchmarkTests workload exercises four clients, 2,000 transactions, 8,000 GL lines, parallel enqueueing, two concurrent durable workers, a 32-line bounded group calculation, six-decimal/high-magnitude amounts and paged reads. One observed local run measured enqueue 147.8 ms, worker processing 134.4 ms, first page 43.8 ms and group calculation 3.2 ms; this is development-capacity evidence only.

Entity packages, restatement lineage, restricted same-currency consolidation, bounded approved foreign-operation translation with pinned rate/policy inputs, explicit DIRECT-rate semantics, maker/checker review and per-line FX lineage, approved-prior-scope group roll-forward lineage for prior run/FX/elimination inputs, group-membership revision pinning with stale-perimeter blocking on approval, calculation and all component/translation/match/journal writes, independently accepted method capability gating, current approved component-package reviews, exact component period/taxonomy/mapping lineage, stale-run publication rechecks, journal lineage, close checks and immutable stage-bound review decisions.
Client-safe validated-package view and signed-in management acknowledgement with explicit client/engagement scope denial; internal review history remains staff-only.
Authorized queue lists only current validated packages in the actor's client/engagement scope and reports management, accounting and partner stage status against exact package versions.

Validated financial packages can create FINANCIAL_PACKAGE release candidates through the completion-screen action and existing guarded approval/release path; issuance rechecks current management, accounting and partner decisions, package generation, checkpoint evidence and existing scope gates.

ECL and inventory assessments capture the exact reconciliation source hash and client input generation; specialist and analytical evidence captures the client input generation; typed asset, payroll, loan, equity, related-party, tax and forecast schedules require the relevant method and evidence; review rejects changed source lineage or client generation with PostgreSQL regression tests.

ECL persists an explicit booked amount and calculates the difference against it; ECL and inventory assessments can retain a same-engagement, non-void proposed-journal link, with base-dataset matching when the reconciliation is dataset-bound. Legacy ECL booked amounts are backfilled from management amounts. PostgreSQL valuation regression, the 212-test suite, Release build, EF drift check and 75-migration loopback restore pass. Migration 20260921085029_LinkValuationDifferencesToAdjustments.

localEvidence.item: Accounting evidence linkage and period governance
localEvidence.details: Typed accounting evidence links require a reviewed scoped audit procedure result; the scoped evidence queue and records export preserve the lineage. Period close is row-locked and package-aware, while authorized reopen creates append-only amendment history and a new working revision.

The Blazor evidence queue no longer treats an engagement-only grant as firm-wide, filters evidence, reconciliations, imports, links and audit results by direct-client or exact-engagement scope, and displays the engagement beside the client and period. Web Release build and JavaScript syntax checks pass at 15ecc76; the PostgreSQL suite remains 213/213.

The accounting workspace distinguishes direct-client grants from exact-engagement grants when presenting engagement labels, package summaries, imports and sealed-import counts; an engagement-only grant cannot widen those views to sibling engagements. Web Release build passes at 33416bb; the PostgreSQL suite remains 213/213.

Structured records exports preserve group perimeter, membership, scope, component, ownership/intercompany, consolidation journal/run, exchange-rate and translation dependencies; the PostgreSQL archive regression passes without copying unrelated client workpapers.

A new group scope can link only to an approved prior scope/run and records the exact prior run hash, approved translation manifest/reserve and recurring-elimination manifest without auto-applying prior journals.
Component, translation, intercompany-match and group-journal commands recheck the pinned group revision and reject writes after a membership change; PostgreSQL regression coverage passes.
The enabled foreign-operation profile accepts only explicit DIRECT rate observations and rejects unsupported inverse direction input; the foreign-operation PostgreSQL regression passes.

Approved ownership edges are retained as evidence, but scope approval fails closed for intermediate or nested hierarchies because the enabled calculators do not yet model those methods; the foreign-operation PostgreSQL regression verifies no nested perimeter can proceed to calculation.

The accounting dashboard, period roll-forward and restatement loaders honor explicit firm-wide, client and engagement grants; an empty grant set fails closed and reports the missing client scope instead of widening to all firm data. The dashboard lists period status and revision and links directly to roll-forward, restatement, evidence and package-review workbenches.
Generated graph artifacts are ignored/untracked and public evidence is redacted. Historical commits were not rewritten.

Shared form behavior adds contextual action and field tooltips derived from labels, placeholders and IDs, required/optional guidance, accessible invalid-state status, and localStorage autosave/restore for card and standalone forms. Drafts flush on input/change, tab backgrounding, pagehide and beforeunload through one shared lifecycle handler; generated scopes avoid collisions for repeated headings, including dynamically added cards; checkbox and radio values restore with their correct types; restored values raise native input and Blazor binding change events; and autosave includes controls disabled during an in-flight action. When localStorage is blocked or full, sessionStorage is tried before the in-memory page-session copy, and reduced durability is reported without interrupting the workflow. Server-backed workpaper drafts remain authoritative; browser file bytes and release keys are intentionally excluded from local storage. Web Release build and JavaScript syntax check plus the 215-test PostgreSQL suite pass at ea2a685; the existing 75-migration loopback restore evidence remains valid.

Assigned staff can create file requests only for active authorized engagements, queue description-rich email bodies with authenticated portal upload links, request additional files and view staff/client messages plus upload events in one timeline. Client replies and communication content are append-only. Existing request-bound upload capabilities remain scoped, and verified staged files are downloadable only after a fresh staff scope check; client download is denied. The isolated Acceptance worker supports mailbox-scoped Graph, SMTP and Resend, records provider acceptance through the durable operation, and stops uncertain outcomes without automatically sending a duplicate. Secrets and tenant identifiers remain outside the repository. Release builds, focused mail delivery coverage, the 223-test PostgreSQL suite, EF drift check and the 83-migration restore rehearsal pass at 21734f0. Live provider acceptance remains external until one provider configuration is exercised.

The journal page rechecks exact client/engagement authorization before display. The export service re-reads the accepted source dataset, raw and normalized digests, reporting period/book basis and currency, exact journal revision and accepted or partial management evidence, then emits a formula-neutralized CSV explicitly marked as not proof of external posting. The UI provides tooltip-guided download and non-disruptive status/error handling. Focused and full PostgreSQL coverage pass at cac843b; approved renderers, artifact hashes/receipts, external posting/provider, signing and records gates remain independent.

The staff package page rechecks exact client/engagement authorization before loading package details, reads only the persisted artifact for the current package revision/generation/hash/template, and offers a guarded text download with non-disruptive status/error handling. Release and delivery remain separate controls. Web Release build, JavaScript syntax check and the 213-test PostgreSQL suite pass at 5d32cf1.

Pinned XLSX and DOCX profiles wrap the exact canonical package without macros or external links; formula-shaped client text remains literal and ZIP metadata is canonicalized. The workbook preserves exactly one renderer-owned COUNTA formula and runtime validation rejects any other formula, VBA project or external workbook part. The pinned PDFsharp/MigraDoc profile embeds an OFL Noto Sans face, paginates on A4, excludes active content and canonicalizes generated identifiers for byte-stable rerendering. Every artifact is SHA-256-bound and persisted against the exact package revision, generation, package hash, framework and template; exact-scope denial, idempotent persistence and Blazor downloads are covered. Release build, 225/225 PostgreSQL tests, model-drift check and the 83-migration loopback restore rehearsal pass at ed6624e. Approved business templates and tenant/provider/signing/records gates remain independent.

Period roll-forward and restatement selection loads use a generation guard so an older client/period response cannot overwrite a newer selection; dependent selectors are locked while loading, and the existing local draft form state is retained. Contextual action tooltips and non-disruptive command guidance remain in place. Web Release build, JavaScript syntax check and the 213-test PostgreSQL suite pass at d81cc65.

Externally prepared component packs now have typed source hashes/digests, line-level reconciliation, independent review, immutable submitted/returned/resubmitted/approved history, compatibility-bridge evidence for changed dates or bases, and approved-pack-only consolidation consumption. Records exports preserve pack provenance and history. PostgreSQL coverage passes with the 212-test Release suite, EF drift check, applied 75-migration schema, and loopback restore drill through 20260921150321_BindMappingsToClientCharts.

Mapping versions persist the exact approved client chart version when a chart exists, reject missing or out-of-scope chart applicability, enforce chart effectiveness across the mapping period, expose chart lineage in the workbench, and preserve it in records exports. PostgreSQL coverage passes with the 212-test Release suite, EF drift check, applied 75-migration schema, and loopback restore drill through 20260921150321_BindMappingsToClientCharts.

The enabled PROVISION_MATRIX_V1 ECL and inventory cost-versus-NRV profiles have PostgreSQL golden and boundary fixtures for expected loss, booked differences, zero-input behavior, unsupported ECL methods and negative inventory inputs. The 214-test PostgreSQL suite and Release build pass at ff3f371; no unapproved valuation method is enabled.

Automatic intercompany matches require one of the enabled receivable/payable, revenue/expense, dividend or investment/equity natures; outside-perimeter reviews remain non-eliminating, approved group-only journals use a distinct kind, and the kind is included in the deterministic run manifest. Unsupported natures fail closed. PostgreSQL ClientAccountingTests, the 215-test suite and Release build pass at cf51b35.

The loopback restore drill compares persisted financial-package, artifact, consolidation scope/run/line and external component-pack manifest identities between source and restored databases, and fails closed when release-delivery identities duplicate. The current rehearsal passed at b92d593 with zero duplicate release-delivery keys; external checkpoint custody and production RPO/RTO remain unrun.

The Blazor accounting workspace now links only to the exact selected package and mapping version when present, and provides scoped TB/GL evidence and package-review routes without broadening authorization or inventing record links. Web Release build and the 215-test PostgreSQL suite pass at 7e832bb.

The enabled direct-rate translation profile now rejects repeated rate observations and translation-policy codes with controlled idempotency conflicts before persistence. Focused foreign-operation coverage, the 215-test PostgreSQL suite and Web Release build pass at ee1d765.
Firm taxonomy overlays accept only generic INDUSTRY or GROUP scopes; a CLIENT-scoped overlay is rejected before persistence. The taxonomy PostgreSQL regression and the 215-test suite pass at 4017ee0.

The zero-adjustment PostgreSQL regression inserts a legacy package with distinct template, calculation-engine version and calculation hash, builds a new canonical package beside it, and verifies both identities remain unchanged and readable. The 215-test suite passes at ad6addb.

Migration 20260922071325_QuarantineLegacyAccountingBackfill binds a nullable legacy trial-balance period only from one exact client, engagement-date, currency and basis candidate, and binds a nullable legacy mapping chart only from one approved chart effective for the mapping period. Zero or multiple candidates leave the original link null and create append-only quarantine evidence. Migration-from-previous-schema coverage, the 220-test PostgreSQL suite, Release build, locked restore, model-drift check and the 81-migration loopback restore rehearsal pass at 5074abc.

An explicit Development/Test-only harness migrates and idempotently seeds the isolated auditsphere_browser database with a QAR SME, two unrelated clients retaining account code 1000 in separate chart scopes, a basic QAR group and an enabled USD-to-QAR group. Built-in-browser journeys verified distinct client context switching, basic and FX group views, approved rate/policy state and corrected v1 scope rendering. The fixed development identity refuses Production startup, cannot coexist with OIDC and rejects non-local return URLs. Release build and 220/220 PostgreSQL tests pass at e595ae0; this is not live-tenant acceptance.

localEvidence.item: Scoped accounting record queues and workflow dashboard
localEvidence.details: Blazor queues expose only exact client/engagement-scoped mapping, adjustment-journal and audit-difference records with detail links. The accounting workspace classifies visible periods as required, complete, stale or blocked, names the next role, uses persisted period-linked work-task or PBC owner/due-date values when available, links unprepared periods to the PBC request or exact period workflow, and retains an explicit Not recorded fallback when no persisted task/PBC date exists. The exact period fallback opens a grant-checked read-only period record with package, mapping, task/PBC, evidence and amendment handoffs. Group consolidation exposes perimeter, component-pack, FX, intercompany and elimination status tabs without enabling unsupported methods. Package-review selection is draft-retained and previews eligible versus partner-role-blocked stages without recording decisions. Release build and the 218-test PostgreSQL suite pass at 188b9ef; the loopback restore drill passes through 20260921204723_AddExchangeRateSetEffectiveRange.

Client ENTITY_REPORTING and AUDIT_ONLY capability profiles persist an explicit service route and require an affirmative accepted or accepted-with-conditions AcceptanceDecision. Missing decisions fail closed; the capability-preparer's staffing role does not substitute for the decision. External component packs remain a separate audit-only input path and do not require client bookkeeping migration. PostgreSQL regression coverage passes.

Currency remeasurement, foreign-operation translation and display-only conversion use distinct deterministic calculation paths. Foreign-operation TranslationResult rows persist separate foreign-exchange and rounding adjustments, archive exports retain those values, and approval recomputes them from the exact source amount and approved rate. Exchange-rate sets persist source, immutable version, approval and effective range metadata while observations retain direction, date and rate type and are range-checked; scope and translation approval reject rate types absent from the approved policy. Migrations 20260921202738_AccountingCapabilityServiceRoute, 20260921203135_TranslationAdjustmentLineage and 20260921204723_AddExchangeRateSetEffectiveRange remain applied; focused FX tests, the 218-test suite, Release build, model-drift check and 80-migration restore drill pass at b7305c1.

Deterministic local calculators cover acquisition goodwill/bargain purchase with fair-value adjustments, NCI rollforward, ownership changes/disposals, nested double-count rejection and asset-transfer/tax elimination math. A fixed candidate fixture combines FX translation/reserve, acquisition goodwill, NCI, nested-scope uniqueness and asset-transfer elimination into balanced QAR current and comparative statements. IFRS method-owner scope is recorded in STE-METH-APP-001-addendum; advanced production profiles remain disabled until source-bound schedules, guarded integration and complete statement verification are implemented.
